info.title: CanFactory API
info.description: Local parametric STL generation. Dimensions are millimetres. Generated jobs and files expire one hour after creation; there are no saved user designs.

post.summary: Reuse a cached STL or enqueue generation
post.description: Returns 200 for a completed cached render or 202 for queued/running work. All fields are required. Poll the returned ID; retry explicitly after failure. No user designs are saved.
